# LaunchLayer

> Independent PC, laptop and Mac repair workshop at 32 Glebe Road, Wickford, Essex SS11 8EU. Free diagnostics, fixed quotes, No-Fix-No-Fee, and free collection and return in Wickford SS11/SS12.

LaunchLayer is a small independent workshop for home users and small businesses. Diagnostics are free. You get a fixed quote before any paid work starts. If a machine cannot be fixed, you do not pay for labour. Free collection and return is for Wickford postcodes SS11 and SS12. Other areas can drop off at the workshop, or call to confirm collection.

## Contact

- Phone: 07367 652987
- Email: hello@launchlayer.uk
- Address: 32 Glebe Road, Wickford, Essex SS11 8EU
- Hours: Mon–Sun, 09:00–22:00
- Website: https://launchlayer.uk/
- Google rating: 5.0 from 32 Google reviews

## Prices

Diagnostics are free. Hardware repairs start from £49. Software fixes start from £45. Laptop battery replacement is £55 labour plus the battery. Charging port (DC jack) repair is £65. Laptop screen fitting is £99 labour plus the panel (MacBook £85 plus the panel). Laptop MOT is £75. Virus removal is £69. Windows reinstall is £59. Full list: [Services & pricing](https://launchlayer.uk/services/).

New parts fitted come with a 12-month hardware warranty. That covers new parts only.

## Service area

Based in Wickford. Free collection and return in SS11 and SS12. Also serves Basildon, Billericay, Brentwood, Chelmsford, Rayleigh and Southend — drop off at the workshop, or collection by arrangement. Stock, Little Burstead, Great Burstead and Queens Park are Billericay (CM11/CM12), not SS11 or SS12.
